text: The formal results prescribe strategies: Theorem 6.2 of arXiv:2311.14125v1 and the pinned Lean correctness theorem fix honest Alice, Bob and Vera strategies (Params.defaults) and quantify over dishonest opponents within fixed types. The experiment reports that LLM debaters, often through poor quote selection, are the bottleneck (Insight 9, App. B.1) and used best-of-N, critique-and-refinement and Elo selection to approach stronger play. Whether agents in a target deployment can play the assumed strategies is unestablished.
title: Assumption: agents can play the strategies the results assume
